description: Perform an attack against a target. Supports advantage/disadvantage and damage type for resistance/vulnerability. Returns an envelope with `outcome` (five-tier) and a one-line `summary` as the headline; mechanical detail is in `result`, follow-up moves in `suggested_next`.

autoTickClockIds.description: Clock IDs to automatically tick on partial/failure outcomes. In worlds that turn clock auto-tick off (mechanics.fitd.clockAutoTick) they are not ticked; they come back as suggested_next.tick_clocks instead.

damageType.description: Damage type (defaults to the weapon's, then 'physical'): picks resistance/vulnerability and, in worlds with Health and Wounds, the wound table

effectLevel.description: Effect level (impact). limited=0.5× damage, standard=1× (default), great=1.5×. Applies to graze damage on partial hits too. Ignored in worlds without position and effect (mechanics.fitd.positionEffect).

position.description: Position (risk level): controlled, risky (default), desperate. Ignored in worlds without position and effect (mechanics.fitd.positionEffect).

name: attack
